description: Update an existing post in the esa team. Requires a post number and optionally accepts updated content, tags, category, WIP status, and other metadata. Returns the updated post information.

message.description: Commit message for the post update.

name.description: Post title. Use # for # and / for / if needed in title.

tags.description: Array of tags to be attached to the post.

wip.description: Whether the post is in WIP (Work in Progress) state.

name: update_post
